title: Orthogonality-Constrained SAEs and Disentangled Safety Concepts

original_idea.body:
# Orthogonality-Constrained SAEs and Disentangled Safety Concepts

**Problem:** OrtSAE enforces orthogonality to reduce absorption; unknown whether it disentangles entangled safety concepts (rudeness vs genuine harm).

**Direction:** Compare OrtSAE vs standard SAE on separating one entangled safety concept pair via activation-overlap and intervention-specificity.

**Why it matters:** Conflating harm concepts produces false alarms/misses. Training-light.

**Relevant context:** OrtSAE; arXiv 2409.14507.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (disentangling reduces monitoring errors) but indirect catastrophic-risk link.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: May require training/obtaining an OrtSAE; intermediate ML fundamentals needed.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused on one entangled concept pair with clear metrics; few dependencies.

low_compute.reasoning: Possibly some SAE training; single mid GPU days.

novelty.reasoning: OrtSAE is very recent; the safety-disentanglement test is likely unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: OrtSAE is new and the safety-concept disentanglement test appears unexplored.
